goal.request: Evaluate whether the frozen controlled_languid_movement_display visual obligations survive one reference-qualified render and at most one targeted repair without modifying the official candidate pack or prompt.

evidence.claim: The frozen candidate pack defines exactly four hard pixel gates: unfinished phase, stable support, alert task attention, and coherent directional lag.
Both reference-qualified runtime requests passed the repository byte-binding audit before generation.
The frozen composed prompt passed its prompt audit and binds one literal runtime sentence to each of the four visual obligations.
Direct thumbnail and native inspection of the initial reference-qualified render passed three gates but failed alert task attention because the eyes addressed the camera instead of the ribbon knot.
One audited targeted repair render completed with no renderer substitution.
Direct thumbnail and native inspection of the repaired render passed all four hard gates; the repair also changed canvas ratio and some fine framing details.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: One adult fashion frame must visibly connect an unfinished drawer-to-knot transition, a coherent planted support chain, awake gaze aimed at the knot, and hair or satin trailing the same movement phase.

invariants.statement: The open start and uncontacted destination remain simultaneously legible.
At least one planted shoe and an uninterrupted ankle-knee-hip path visibly carry the transition.
Open eyes and head direction converge on the visible hand destination rather than the camera.
At least one permitted flexible material trails the leading motion at a distinct phase without generic blur.

mismatches.source_state: Eyes should converge on the ribbon knot immediately beyond the reaching fingertips.
mismatches.render_state: Initial eyes were awake but converged toward the camera/viewer.

hypotheses.statement: The generator's fashion-editorial camera-gaze prior overrode the prompt's task-linked gaze clause in the initial render.
hypotheses.falsifier: A repeated frozen-prompt sample consistently aims the eyes at the knot without repair, or a gaze-only repair leaves the eyes on the camera.

intervention.general_rule: No skill, profile, candidate-pack, or prompt change is authorized from this isolated frozen-arm motivating case.
intervention.generalization_basis: A single motivating render followed by one case-scoped repair cannot establish a transferable rule.

decision.rationale: The repaired motivating render passes all four required pixel gates, but the initial task-gaze failure, repair collateral changes, absence of an unrelated held-out render, and pending user judgment do not support profile or candidate-pack promotion.
